cmd: sh -c node dist/migrate-cli.js migrate; ec=$?; if [ -f /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak ]; then echo LIVE_GATES_MEMORY_PEAK_BYTES=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak); elif [ -f /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.max_usage_in_bytes ]; then echo LIVE_GATES_MEMORY_PEAK_BYTES=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.max_usage_in_bytes); else echo LIVE_GATES_MEMORY_PEAK_BYTES=unavailable; fi; sleep 5; exit $ec
